description: Worldwide weather forecast for any latitude/longitude from MET Norway Locationforecast 2.0 (the Norwegian Meteorological Institute; CC BY 4.0): current conditions (temperature, humidity, wind speed and direction, pressure, cloud cover, next-hour precipitation, condition text) and up to 9 daily summaries (min/max, precipitation total, max wind, dominant condition), optional hourly series, metric or imperial units, local-time grouping by any IANA zone. Cached per MET Norway Expires headers. Use /v1/weather-nws for US NWS alerts. Price: $0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/weather-global

altitude.description: Optional ground altitude in metres (improves temperature in mountains)

hourly.description: Include the hourly series for the requested days (default false)

tz.description: IANA zone used to group days and format local times (default UTC)

name: weather_global
title: Weather Global
